The Vietnam Museum of Ethnology, an organization under the Vietnam Academy of Social Sciences, is dedicated to scientific research, collecting, inventorying, preserving, restoring objects and materials related to ethnic groups, organizing exhibitions, performances, and other activities to introduce, disseminate, and educate about the historical and cultural values of ethnic groups both within and outside the country. It also provides research materials on ethnic groups for various sectors and trains researchers, professionals, and managers in ethnographic museum studies.
